creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From #153, batch 8, item 3.

In a command block, constraints must come before `default` and `calls`. Putting one after them, as `args:` blocks allow, produces two errors that point elsewhere:

```rad
command go:
    ---
    Go.
    ---
    a x bool
    b y bool
    default
    calls do_go
    a mutually excludes b
```

```
error[RAD10022]: 'default' outside of switch statement
error[RAD40020]: Command 'go' does nothing
```

Neither names the constraint line, and RAD10022 names a correctly placed `default` and a switch the script does not contain. Either accept constraints after `calls`, or report the misplaced constraint.

Confirmed on main (3459ddf1).

Where: tree-sitter-rad command block rule; RAD10022 comes from the ERROR-node heuristics (9b4d2e80).
title: A constraint after default/calls in a command block gives a switch error
